title: Pure Worm
summary: The Worm archetype is a Duel Terminal LIGHT Reptile Flip-control and board-breaking engine built around the iconic duo Worm Xex and Worm Yagan, backed by one of the strongest archetype Traps ever printed: W Nebula Meteorite! Normal Summon Level 4 Worm Xex to send Worm Yagan directly from your Deck to the GY—which immediately triggers Worm Yagan in the GY to Special Summon itself in face-down Defense Position (and makes Worm Xex indestructible by battle while you control Yagan!). On your opponent's turn, flip W Nebula Meteorite to flip Yagan face-up (bouncing an opponent's face-up monster to the hand!), then during the End Phase, W Nebula Meteorite flips all LIGHT Reptiles back face-down, draws 1 card for EACH of them, AND Special Summons Level 8 Worm King (2700 ATK; tributes Reptiles to destroy cards on the field!) or Worm Victory directly from your Deck!

allow.Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant: Level 4 LIGHT Reptile (matches the LIGHT Reptile Type/Attribute required by W Nebula Meteorite!) that sends Nauya or Worm Yagan/Victory from your Deck to the GY and revives itself while you control a Reptile to link into Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame or Reptilianne Echidna!
allow.Nauya, the Ogdoadic Remnant: Level 4 DARK Reptile that sends a LIGHT Reptile (Worm Yagan, Worm Victory, or Nunu) from your Deck to the GY.
allow.Snake Rain: Iconic Reptile Normal Spell: discards 1 card to send 4 Reptile 'Worm' monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY—immediately triggering Worm Yagan if you control Worm Xex, boosting Worm Victory by +2000 ATK, and loading Worm Zero's materials!
allow.Polymerization: Fuses Reptile 'Worm' monsters from your hand and/or field into the multi-effect boss Worm Zero.
allow.Reptilianne Echidna: Link-2 DARK Reptile (2 monsters including a Reptile) that reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and searches Reptile monsters with different names from your Deck up to the number of 0 ATK monsters they control!
allow.Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame: Link-2 LIGHT Reptile (2 Reptile monsters) that discards 1 monster as a Quick Effect to distribute A-Counters, and revives Reptiles with different names from your GY when destroyed.
allow.Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll: Link-3 LIGHT Reptile boss (2+ Reptile monsters) that locks opposing monsters with A-Counters into Defense Position and negates their effects.

main: Worm Xex

Core Level 4 LIGHT Reptile starter (1800 ATK): when Normal Summoned, sends 1 Reptile 'Worm' monster ('Worm Yagan'!) directly from your Deck to the GY; and while you control a face-up 'Worm Yagan', this card CANNOT be destroyed by battle!
Worm Yagan

Core Level 4 LIGHT Reptile partner (1800 DEF): if the only monster you control is 'Worm Xex', you can Special Summon this card from your GY in face-down Defense Position; when flipped face-up (by an attack or W Nebula Meteorite!), targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and returns it to the hand!
Worm King

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Reptile boss (2700 ATK): can be Tribute Summoned in face-up Attack Position by Tributing just 1 Reptile 'Worm' monster, OR Special Summoned directly from your Deck by W Nebula Meteorite during the End Phase; tributes 1 Reptile 'Worm' monster (not once per turn!) to target 1 card your opponent controls and destroy it!
Worm Victory

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Reptile Flip boss (0 ATK / 2500 DEF; Special Summoned from Deck by W Nebula Meteorite!): when flipped face-up, destroys all face-up monsters on the field, except Reptile 'Worm' monsters; and gains 500 ATK for EACH Reptile 'Worm' monster in your GY!
Worm Cartaros

Core Level 4 LIGHT Reptile Flip searcher: when flipped face-up (including by W Nebula Meteorite!), adds ANY Level 4 or lower Reptile 'Worm' monster ('Worm Xex', 'Worm Tentacles', or 'Worm Linx'!) from your Deck to your hand!
Worm Linx
Level 2 LIGHT Reptile Flip draw engine: once flipped face-up, during EACH player's End Phase, if this card is face-up, draws 1 card!
Worm Tentacles
Level 4 LIGHT Reptile (1700 ATK): banishes 1 Reptile 'Worm' monster from your GY once per turn to make a second attack during each Battle Phase.
Worm Apocalypse
Level 1 LIGHT Reptile Flip: when flipped face-up, targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field and destroys it (and provides a 5th/6th different Worm name for Worm Zero!).
Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant

Level 4 LIGHT Reptile: sends Nauya or Worm Yagan from your Deck to the GY to revive itself while you control a Reptile (like Worm Xex!) for an instant link play into Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame or Reptilianne Echidna!
Nauya, the Ogdoadic Remnant
Level 4 DARK Reptile: sends a LIGHT Reptile (Worm Yagan, Worm Victory, or Nunu) from your Deck to the GY.
Snake Rain

Discards 1 card to send 4 Reptile 'Worm' monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY—immediately triggering Worm Yagan if you control Worm Xex, boosting Worm Victory by +2000 ATK, and loading Worm Zero's materials!
Polymerization
Fuses Reptile 'Worm' monsters from your hand and/or field into the multi-effect boss Worm Zero.
W Nebula Meteorite

Signature Normal Trap: changes all face-down monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position (triggering Worm Yagan's monster-bounce, Worm Cartaros's search, and Worm Victory's board-wipe!); THEN during the End Phase of this turn, changes all face-up LIGHT Reptile monsters you control to face-down Defense Position, draws 1 card for EACH of them, and Special Summons 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT Reptile ('Worm King' or 'Worm Victory'!) directly from your Deck!
extra: Ultimate Level 10 LIGHT Reptile Fusion boss (2+ Reptile 'Worm' monsters): gains 500 ATK for each Fusion Material used with a different name, and gains cumulative effects based on the number of different-name materials: 2+: once per turn Special Summons 1 Reptile from your GY in face-down Defense Position; 4+: banishes 1 Reptile from your GY to send 1 monster on the field to the GY; 6+: draws 1 card once per turn!

Link-2 DARK Reptile (2 monsters including a Reptile): makes an opponent's monster's ATK 0 on Link Summon, and searches Reptile monsters with different names from your Deck up to the number of 0 ATK monsters they control!
Link-2 LIGHT Reptile (2 Reptile monsters): discards 1 monster as a Quick Effect to distribute A-Counters, and revives Reptiles with different names from your GY when destroyed.
Link-3 LIGHT Reptile boss (2+ Reptile monsters) that locks opposing monsters with A-Counters into Defense Position and negates their effects.
